items.reason: Exact alarms come only from the member's own switch (USE_EXACT_ALARM dropped for Play policy); camera and notification permission asked only when used; Play shows no policy issue. Hevy share-link copying through a hidden browser is the known fault. The Play data safety form itself was not in the machine report, so it could not be compared with what these files keep.
No iPhone build: these files hold no iPhone-only code; the rest card, exact alarms and watch install are Android and Wear OS only.

Bell, beep and whistle are made by our own script; the default chime (rest-done.wav) and the record chime (record.wav) have no recorded maker or licence (same fault as the known chime finding). Strength level numbers cite ExRx/Kilgore and Symmetric Strength as sources of facts, no copied text or pictures. Trainer video links point to the gym's own YouTube links, nothing shipped.
